risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- As a company with a predominantly export-oriented business model, ongoing geopolitical conflicts (Russia-Ukraine war, Iran war) in the Middle East and Europe have severely disrupted global supply chains, trade flows and market volatility.
- Persistently high container shipping costs, limited availability, and frequent delays pose serious operational challenges for the export-oriented business.
- Inadequate and inefficient domestic logistics infrastructure continues to contribute to longer transit times and elevated costs, further impacting competitiveness.
- Cotton is the biggest cost component and an agricultural produce subject to climatic and seasonal volatility; cotton prices are increasing regularly along with other input costs including power, fuel and logistics.
- The textile industry is always subject to facing crisis in a cyclical way, requiring timely corrective and proactive action.
- The industry faces intense competition from low-cost manufacturing countries such as Bangladesh, Vietnam and China.
- Heavy dependence on exports makes the industry vulnerable to global economic slowdowns, changing trade policies, and currency fluctuations.
- The Company is susceptible to disasters and crises such as cyclones, earthquakes, geopolitical instability and fire hazards, which may cause operational disruption, shutdown or production cuts, project delays, supply chain hurdles, and increased costs.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Operate as a vertically integrated textile player, with a streamlined focus on core marketing capabilities expected to enhance operational efficiency, drive economies of scale, strengthen margins, and offer more focused leadership and management attention to the textile business.
- Continuous infrastructure upgradations to achieve the greatest level of customer satisfaction and excellent business relations, with a special focus on adopting sustainable business processes.
